A six year old does not deserve to be in poverty. Full stop.⁣
⁣
Every kid in poverty is a policy failure. But since kids don't have separate incomes, you can't help the kid without helping the household they're in. That's the whole political tension. https://youtu.be/gL2kxIbPitU

Some economic history of the American right. One of these is not like the other.⁣
1930's: Oppose the New Deal⁣
1960's: Goldwater's smaller-government⁣
1980's: Reagan's tax cuts⁣
1990's: Deregulation and free trade⁣
2020's: Tariffs and protectionism
